# Bee Happy Building Systems

> Bee Happy Building Systems is a family owned and operated metal building
> contractor based in the Tyler/Arp, Texas area, serving Tyler, Longview, and
> the greater East Texas region. The company designs and constructs
> barndominiums, steel workshops, agricultural barns, detached garages,
> commercial steel buildings, and RV/boat covers using 100% US-made steel,
> and is fully insured and bonded with 20+ years of experience.

Bee Happy Building Systems builds on three engineered systems, matched to a
client's budget and timeline: red iron steel (heavy-gauge structural steel
spanning wide clear areas with zero interior support columns), hybrid steel
frame (steel columns paired with wood framing for a cost-effective, fully
engineered build), and post frame construction (embedded posts for a fast,
budget-friendly build ideal for barns and shops). [PLACEHOLDER: confirm
founding year, licensing/bonding registration details, and any
certifications before final shipment.]

## Services

- [Custom Barndominiums](https://beehappybuildings.com/#barndominiums): High-grade steel frames with luxury interiors — energy-efficient, open-concept living at a fraction of the cost of traditional builds.
- [Steel Workshops](https://beehappybuildings.com/#steel-workshops): Metal workshops and hobby shops engineered to withstand Texas winds, with secure, clear-span space for any project.
- [Agricultural Barns](https://beehappybuildings.com/#agricultural-barns): Heavy-duty metal farm buildings for livestock, hay storage, and equipment, built with rust-resistant steel.
- [Detached Garages](https://beehappybuildings.com/#detached-garages): Premium metal garage construction with reinforced steel siding, ideal for vehicle storage, home gyms, or man-caves, with custom roll-up door options.
- [Commercial Steel Buildings](https://beehappybuildings.com/#commercial-steel): Scalable industrial metal buildings for retail, office space, or manufacturing, with rapid turn-key construction.
- [RV & Boat Covers](https://beehappybuildings.com/#rv-boat-covers): Custom steel RV carports and boat covers engineered for maximum clearance and protection against sun and hail damage.

## Materials & Construction Systems

- Red Iron Steel: Heavy-gauge structural steel that spans wide clear areas with zero interior support columns. The standard for barndominiums and shops.
- Hybrid Steel Frame: Steel columns paired with wood framing for a cost-effective, fully engineered build.
- Post Frame Construction: Embedded posts deliver a fast, budget-friendly, fully engineered build, ideal for barns and shops.

## Pages

- [Home](https://beehappybuildings.com/): Company overview, services, gallery preview, FAQ, and quote request form.
- [Gallery](https://beehappybuildings.com/gallery/): Photos of completed projects, organized into Barndos and Sheds.
- [Blog](https://beehappybuildings.com/blog/): Buyer's guides on construction systems, fasteners, roof coatings, and windows.
- [Red Iron, Hybrid Steel & Post Frame: Choosing Your Construction Process](https://beehappybuildings.com/blog/construction-process.html): How the three construction systems Bee Happy builds on compare, and how to choose.
- [Metal Roof & Building Fasteners: A Straight-Talk Guide](https://beehappybuildings.com/blog/fastener-guide.html): The four roofing/building fasteners Bee Happy installs, what each is for, and why fastener choice affects roof lifespan.
- [Beat the Texas Heat: A Guide to Metal Roof Color & Coatings](https://beehappybuildings.com/blog/roof-color-coatings-guide.html): How roof color and coating (Signature 200 SMP vs. Signature 300 PVDF, and bare Galvalume) affect heat gain and energy costs in East Texas.
- [Premium Windows Compared: Pella vs. Andersen vs. Marvin](https://beehappybuildings.com/blog/premium-windows-guide.html): Materials, finishes, pricing, and warranty comparison of premium window brands for East Texas heat.
- [Budget & In-Stock Windows Compared](https://beehappybuildings.com/blog/budget-windows-guide.html): How RELIABILT, Ply Gem, Elevate, and Simonton budget vinyl windows compare on U-Factor, SHGC, DP rating, and warranty.
